ModMetadata.Name: TMZ Opcode Extensions
ModMetadata.Author: tasermonkey
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]TMZ Opcode Extensions (tmz-opext)[/h1] This is a Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Adds IC10 opcodes for calling functions with a real call stack: a call saves the registers you choose and the line to return to, passes up to five values, and comes back with one, in one instruction each way.
[b]What this mod adds[/b] [list] [*] [b]tmsi base count[/b]: starts a call stack at stack address [i]base[/i], growing down. Each call saves r0 up to r(count-1) (0 to 16 registers) and the line to return to. Sets ra to the stack's top. [*] [b]tmjc r? target a b c d e[/b]: calls the function at the line or label [i]target[/i], with up to five values in r0-r4. Its return value lands in [i]r?[/i]. [*] [b]tmjr value[/b]: returns from the last call: restores its registers and ra, and puts the value in the caller's [i]r?[/i]. [/list]
[b]Example[/b] [code] tmsi 511 16 move r1 43 tmjc r0 double r1 s db Setting r0 # 86 yield double: mul r0 r0 2 tmjr r0 [/code]
Calls nest, and recurse. [i]ra[/i] is the call stack's pointer, so don't use jal while a call is open. push and pop still work, from address 0 up.
In multiplayer every player needs the mod.
